facts.value: The University Computer Centre (HRZ) provides students with necessary IT services for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.) and offers consultation and support for technical problems.
The phone hotline of Goethe University helps with questions regarding application, semester dates, re-registration, subject change, dual study programs, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Central Student Advisory Service assists with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, subject change, dual study programs, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provides information for international students on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more. They also offer consultation and support.

The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to ensure that students find the necessary infrastructure for successful studying in areas such as educational funding and student housing, as well as in canteens, cafeterias, and counseling and support facilities.
